hints.title: Interval Game State
hints.text: Subproblems correspond to subarrays stones[i..j]. Precompute prefix sums to query range sums in O(1).

hints.title: Evaluate Both Removals
hints.text: Removing stones[i] earns sum(i + 1..j) minus optimal score difference of stones[i + 1..j].

hints.title: Maximize Net Differential
hints.text: Take maximum of (sum(i + 1..j) - dp[i + 1][j]) and (sum(i..j - 1) - dp[i][j - 1]).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursion without memoization explores O(2^n) game tree branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval dynamic programming memoizes n * (n + 1) / 2 states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates minimax interval DP relation with prefix sums.
